name: web-service
description: v3: a small runnable Node service (src/server.js, Dockerfile) and a kustomize base in deploy/k8s with a Deployment and Service per in-cluster node and NetworkPolicies from the architecture's connects relationships. 3.0.1 gives the policies valid Kubernetes names when a relationship's unique-id is not one (upper case, `_` and so on); ids that already are keep their names. Use 3.0.1, not 3.0.0.
